title: Middle East live: Cargo ship hit by 'unknown projectile' in Strait of Hormuz
summary: Early Tuesday, Britain's maritime security agency UKMTO said that a cargo vessel was struck by an "unknown projectile" in the Strait of Hormuz off the coast of Oman.
